class.name: robot_filtered_joint_state_broadcaster/FilteredJointStateBroadcaster
class.description: Whole-body filtered joint state broadcaster. Reads pos/vel/eff state interfaces for every joint in the `joints` parameter, applies a per-joint first-order IIR low-pass on velocity and effort, and publishes a sensor_msgs/JointState on the configured topic. Position is unfiltered.
